purpose: Independent external benchmark of Gradiom published pre-vote aggregate forecasts; no model training or promotion.
horizon: Retain printed generation date; require strictly before vote; historical snapshot authenticity not independently certified. No 2026-11-29 data.
metrics: Macro-object equal-municipality MAE in percentage points, centered local MAE, national MAE from published national forecast, equal-canton macro-object MAE when exact canton values available. Score only final/complete published official aggregate counts; label provisional releases. Report actual coverage, unmatched keys and uncertainty across dates.
comparison: Compare same objects on existing frozen V2 2023-25 retrospective comparison results when matched. Equal-geography matched rows required for strict paired commune comparison; if only per-object metrics or geography differs, label indicative. V10.8 score 6.9886 on separate 2016-22 population is contextual only. No fitting or selection on 2023+ results.
provenance: Save URLs, published dates, retrieval time and hashes. Public values only; do not publish full proprietary tables or circumvent access restrictions.
geography: Read declared SVG map vintage and official OGD spatial_reference, validate IDs against official registers and exclude both sides of all mutations, including territory transfers, between vintages. Require >=95% of count-valid official communes. Only use numeric data-approval in map data-quantile 50; not colors. Exclude special units. Allow complete provisional official votes but label them.

paired_replay.training: 1990-2022 (306 objects), no post-2022 targets in fitting or tuning; V2 exact historical replay checked against all 18 archived comparison object scores
variants: same V2 cutoff aligned to printed Gradiom generation day
fixed V10.8 page_tfidf_16_all with national anchor and preexisting missing regional margins fallback
paired_replay.horizon: 11-day same-calendar-date cutoff at 23:59:59 Europe/Zurich; exact Gradiom generation hour unverified. SSR wave 2 printed publication same date for all seven. No later surveys. Source version/publication proxies unchanged.
paired_replay.corpus: Frozen V10.8 historical corpus artifact 14906199977; existing unique source/date/hash/question page matching for all seven query objects; title fallback. No text extraction from outcomes.
paired_replay.metrics: Identical matched municipality-object keys and latest official observed percentages; per-object macro MAE, centered MAE, signed bias, paired-date bootstrap on three dates. Report V2 replay error and any revisions; exposed 2023-25 comparison, not independent.
